newsitem.title: UK: PETsMART to invest 200 mln stg in Europe.
newsitem.headline: PETsMART to invest 200 mln stg in Europe.

text.p: U.S. pet store PETsMART Inc said on Friday it would invest 200 million stg to expand its operations in Europe.
The company, which bought Britain's Pet City last year, said it would rebrand that chain as part of a planned a 30-store opening roll-out in the UK.
By 1998, the total number of stores in Britain will be 88, resulting in the creation of 1,000 new jobs, PETsMART said in a statement released here.
The company said its existing head office in Swindon, southern England, would act as European headquarters for another 1,000 stores planned to open in Europe over the next five years.
Adding to this, the U.S. expansion programme will grow the existing base of 331 outlets to 1,000 stores, the firm said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
